metadata.title: Clermont priority prospecting sectors
metadata.description: Research-derived prospectivity polygons for all twelve Clermont GPAs, clipped to official Queensland GPA and current tenure geometry. Includes Black Ridge, Birimgan East and West, Four Mile East and West, Bathampton, Flat Diggings, Brigalow, McMasters, McDonald Flat, Museum Reserve and Town Reserve. Not a legal access determination and not a guarantee of gold.
official_sources: Queensland Mining Administrative Areas MapServer layer 20
Queensland Detailed Geology MapServer layers 4 and 15
Queensland Central gold district maps and special conditions
metadata.required_display_note: Indicative prospectivity only. A fossicking licence and same-day tenure, access, signage and closure checks are required.

properties.name: Black Ridge contact-proximity pocket
properties.basis: Open GPA ground within 150 m of mapped Blair Athol Coal Measures to Hurleys Metamorphics contact, clipped against current ML and MC layers.
properties.legal_status: Indicative open GPA prospectivity only. Recheck current tenure, access, signs and closures before entry.
properties.state_forest_conditions: Daylight only; hand tools and metal detectors only; no excavation at toe of stream bank or in a gully; keep 10 m from infrastructure; follow signs and closures.
properties.source_crs: GDA2020 / MGA zone 55; exported as WGS84 longitude/latitude
properties.drainage_interpretation: Named drainage is source-to-trap context only. Target benches, shallow residual wash and permitted margins, not active channels, gullies or stream-bank toes.
